name: Erryn C.
quote: We hired Makenzie for my son’s wedding. She did an amazing job handling the setup and takedown. She took care of all the details, including packing up all the supplies at the end of the night, so our family could relax and truly enjoy the special day. Her help was such a blessing, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for someone reliable and helpful for their special event!

name: Lexi R.
quote: Makenzie was the most professional & worthwhile vendor we hired for my wedding in April. With a very limited amount of information on my DIY wedding, & minimal time to prepare, Makenzie was able to entirely execute, and exceed any ideas I had for my dream wedding. Coordinating with vendors, setting up, and the tear down of the entire (3 location) event space before midnight would have been absolutely impossible by myself, and a huge burden on my loved ones on my special day. My Husband and I decided to thrift and source all of the decor for our wedding which meant truckloads of boxes that needed to be sorted through and displayed. Makenzie turned what should’ve been a 12 hour set up job, into 4. The confidence she exudes in her business and organizational skills radiates; which led me, (a stressed out, DIY bride) to fully trust in her capabilities and allow myself to actually relax and enjoy the day of. My Husband and I could not be happier; Makenzie made our dream wedding a reality, it truly could not have happened without her.
